criteria.name: card
criteria.expect: a top-level item 800x480 at pos 0 0, white, corner-radius 12

criteria.name: tabs
criteria.expect: a 48 high tab bar with three equal tabs reading Overview, Members, Settings

criteria.name: active
criteria.expect: Overview has #201240 text and a 2 px #6b3ad3 underline; Members and Settings are #6b7280 without one

criteria.name: panel
criteria.expect: a panel below the bar fills the remaining height, padded 24, with the title Overview and a 320x120 #f7f8fa block

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a card with three tabs, the first underlined, no warnings
